sentences.text: Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Avesh Mishra

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Mrs. Sadhna Rani (Thakur),J.
Learned counsel for the applicants is present.

In compliance of the Court's order dated 21.11.2023, the trial court has transmitted the photocopy of the compromise deed, photocopy of the verification order dated 19.12.2023 passed on the compromise deed and the affidavit of the opposite party No.2 Meera Rani.

According to the order of the trial court dated 19.12.2023 the parties, who were identified by their respective counsels, were appeared before the trial court and the compromise between the parties was verified by the trial court.

As the trial court has transmitted the photocopy of the compromise deed and the verification order passed thereon, hence, the photocopies of the compromise deed and the verification order dated 19.12.2023 passed thereon are accepted.
The dispute being matrimonial and personal, the compromise is admitted.

As the compromise between the parties is verified by the trial court and has been accepted by this Jay Singh And 5 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/139839571/
1 Court, the verification order dated 19.12.2023 is also on record, both the compromise deed and the verification order dated 19.12.2023 shall form part of the order.
